title: AMPSphere: antimicrobial peptides from the global microbiome
summary: Machine learning identified 863,498 candidate sequences in microbial genomes and metagenomes. Of 100 synthesized peptides, 63 inhibited at least one of the eleven strains tested; some showed activity in animal models. The catalog contains candidates, not hundreds of thousands of clinically validated antibiotics.

evidence.tested: 100 predicted peptides were synthesized and tested in vitro and in vivo against drug-resistant pathogens and human gut commensals; 63 inhibited pathogens.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states no limitations and does not name the strains or animal models used.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning predicted antimicrobial peptides across 63,410 metagenomes and 87,920 genomes, producing a catalog of 863,498 non-redundant candidates.
